Elevate your bedroom decor with this personalized Baseball Comforter Set from Jeminise, perfect for any baseball fan. This set combines the comfort of brushed polyester fabric with a spirited baseball design, offering a unique touch to your sleeping space.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Design: Show your love for baseball with a design that celebrates determination and the spirit of the game.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Crafted from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric with a Whole-Piece Microfiber Filling, ensuring a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed sizes.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features an environmental protection finishing process that prevents fading, along with smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting durability.
  • Personalized Options: Customize with up to 2 text inputs for a truly unique bedding set.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat for quick drying and a fluffier result.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover, perfect for a complete bedding refresh.
